buildCommand: for py in python3.12 python3.13 python3.14 python3 python; do command -v "$py" >/dev/null 2>&1 && "$py" -c 'import fastapi, pydantic_core, PIL' >/dev/null 2>&1 && echo "explore_static: using $py" && "$py" -B -m modules.register.explore_static --live && exit 0; done; rm -rf /tmp/einkviews-explore; python3 -m pip install -q --target /tmp/einkviews-explore -r requirements.txt && echo 'explore_static: using temp deps /tmp/einkviews-explore' && PYTHONPATH=/tmp/einkviews-explore python3 -B -m modules.register.explore_static --live || echo 'explore_static: WARNING skipped, keeping the committed public/pages/explore.html'
